document: Sobha Collections Platform — Validation + Final Structure

section_size_issues.detail: Growth Trajectory submodule alone carries 8 charts covering 5 distinct analytical themes: annual entity bars, % mix trend, monthly composition stacked, LP charges, and units by year. These are 5 independent questions bundled into one submodule.
section_size_issues.recommended_split: Split Growth Trajectory into two submodules: (1) Annual Collections Story — entity annual bars + growth KPIs; (2) Collections Composition — mix % trend + LP + units. Reduce S01 from 15 charts to 12 by consolidating entity-toggled variants.

section_size_issues.issue: OVER-SCOPED — 4 domain themes in one section, 9 submodules in blueprint
section_size_issues.detail: S06 combines: QCG receipt quality (R31), payment channel technology (R25), PR-SOA process (R20), financial charges (R26), and helpdesk operations (R29). These are owned by different teams with different KPI cadences and different audiences.
section_size_issues.recommended_split: Formalise as 3 named submodules with distinct domain ownership: (1) Receipt Quality — QCG/Garima; (2) Payment Infrastructure — Technology track; (3) Charges & Support — Finance/Operations. Already aligned with blueprint but must be enforced as hard boundaries in rendering.

submodule_overload_issues.issue: OVERLOADED — snapshot doughnut + trend chart + project ranking + SPA legal status + 16 KPIs in one submodule
submodule_overload_issues.detail: OD Analysis currently mixes four distinct questions: What is the ageing position now? (doughnut), How has ageing evolved? (monthly trend), Which projects are worst? (bar), What is the legal status of OD? (SPA chart). These require separate visual contexts and scroll positions.
submodule_overload_issues.recommended_split: Split into: (1) OD Position — KPI strip only; (2) OD Snapshot — doughnut + projects + SPA; (3) OD Progression — monthly trend TREND_PANEL. The blueprint already separates 4.2 from 4.3 but KPIs are still bundled with 4.2.

submodule_overload_issues.issue: MIXED OWNERSHIP — agent coverage (R10, operational) and payment channel doughnut (R25, transactional) have different owners and different update frequencies
submodule_overload_issues.detail: Coverage is a daily operational metric tracking RM activity. Channel mix is a structural trend tracking customer payment behaviour. Combining them in one submodule obscures both signals.
submodule_overload_issues.recommended_split: Split into: (1) Coverage — 5-bucket bars + coverage KPIs (stays in S03 as pulse metric); (2) Payment Channel Snapshot — current-period doughnut only (stays in S03). The longitudinal channel shift (c-paych 3yr grouped bar) moves exclusively to S06 Payment Infrastructure.

submodule_overload_issues.issue: OVERLOADED — 8 charts covering annual collections, % mix evolution, monthly stacked, LP charges, and units by year
submodule_overload_issues.detail: A reader cannot consume 8 charts with 5 different questions under one submodule heading without losing the thread. Each chart pair answers a different executive question.
submodule_overload_issues.recommended_split: Annual Collections Story (entity annual bars + CAGR KPIs) is one narrative unit. Collections Composition (% mix trend + LP charges + units by year) is a second narrative unit. Split into two submodules.

metrics_duplication.issue: Computed from R08 independently in all three sections. Shadow risk if source data updates.
metrics_duplication.resolution: Compute once as global derived constant CY_ADV_MIX_YTD = 81.1%. Reference in S01, S03, S05 — never recompute.

metrics_duplication.issue: Near-identical KPI blocks. S02 frames it as a strategic summary; S03 frames it as a live operational pulse. The values are identical.
metrics_duplication.resolution: Keep in both sections but with explicit purpose labels. S02 = 'Year-to-Date Summary (Strategic)'. S03 = 'Q1 Actuals vs MDO (Operational Pulse)'. Mark as cross-referenced, not duplicated. Same source R02.

metrics_duplication.issue: Same values rendered in two KPI strips with no differentiation in framing.
metrics_duplication.resolution: S01 context = historical growth story (2021→2025 trajectory). S02 context = current stock position. Values are identical but framing justifies both. Add context labels. Source R01 for both.

metrics_duplication.issue: SAME CHART rendered in two sections. c-adv-3yr in S01 and c-adv-hist in S05 are the same 3-year monthly overlay. Duplication of rendering logic and data arrays.
metrics_duplication.resolution: REMOVE from S01. Single authoritative render in S05 as TREND_PANEL (c-adv-hist). S01 Advance Narrative becomes a KPI_STRIP only — references 3yr context via headline numbers (3,260M, +125%, +238%) without re-rendering the chart.

metrics_duplication.issue: Figures appear in both sections. S01 shows them as KPIs; S05 shows them again as advisory context.
metrics_duplication.resolution: S01 owns the financial model KPIs — 652M, 21M, 31M clearly labelled PROJECTED. S05 Rebate Strategy INSIGHT_BLOCK references the S01 finding by name only ('see NPV Rebate Analysis in Strategic Narrative'). No re-display of the numbers in S05.

metrics_duplication.issue: The PIPELINE_ADV_DENOM = 37.8B definition is explained twice within the same section: once inline with the chart and again in the DEFINITION_BLOCK.
metrics_duplication.resolution: State denominator definition ONCE in DEFINITION_BLOCK only. Chart tooltip and KPI annotations reference the constant by name (PIPELINE_ADV_DENOM = 37.8B) — not re-explained.

unclear_boundaries.boundary: S01 Advance Deep Dive vs S05 Advance Collections
unclear_boundaries.issue: Both sections show advance data in overlapping depth. S01 has 3 charts + 6 KPIs on advance. S05 has 6 charts + 9 KPIs on advance. The division between 'narrative summary' and 'management detail' is not enforced in v5.
unclear_boundaries.resolution: S01 RULE: advance data in S01 is KPI-only (totals, growth %, NPV KPIs). No charts that are also in S05. The single exception — advance quarterly (c-adv-qtr) — stays in S01 as it shows the narrative acceleration story not shown elsewhere. S05 owns all monthly/CY/FY/penetration charts.

unclear_boundaries.boundary: S04 IC Threshold Risk Flags vs S08 Risk Exposure Summary
unclear_boundaries.issue: 251 units / 907.7M appears as an INSIGHT_BLOCK in S04 and as a KPI_STRIP in S08. The S08 strip re-displays S04 data without differentiation.
unclear_boundaries.resolution: S04 = Operational flag (what is the current risk in the portfolio today). S08 = Strategic advisory (what should the board decide about this risk). S08 KPI_STRIP carries a link label 'Source: S04 Risk Flags' and adds the policy context. Data not re-fetched — S08 reads from S04 constants.

unclear_boundaries.boundary: S03 Payment Channel Doughnut vs S06 Payment Channel Grouped Bar
unclear_boundaries.issue: S03 shows c-channel (current period units paid by channel — doughnut). S06 shows c-paych (3-year grouped bar — longitudinal shift). In v5 these are in the same S06 section, creating confusion between pulse and trend.
unclear_boundaries.resolution: MOVE c-channel to S03 Coverage & Channel submodule — it is a current-period operational metric (what channel did customers use THIS month). KEEP c-paych in S06 Payment Infrastructure — it is a longitudinal transformation story (how channel mix has shifted over 3 years). These are now explicitly different chart types in different sections.

unclear_boundaries.boundary: S02 Portfolio Cards entity OD vs S04 OD Position KPI_STRIP
unclear_boundaries.issue: Both show entity OD values. S02 shows Sobha 1.47B / Siniya 166M / DT 11M. S04 shows Group OD 1.65B. All source from R18. No clear rule on which is authoritative for entity-level OD.
unclear_boundaries.resolution: S02 = Entity-level OD (entity toggle context, part of portfolio snapshot). S04 = Group-level OD analysis (ageing, composition, trend). Both use OD_TODAY constant from R18. No conflict — different granularity of the same signal.
